full_prompt:
TASK: Create one isolated transparent PNG sprite asset for an RPG map object.
Small oval running track sprite for the upper-right part of a rural field map, reddish packed-earth loop surrounding a simple inner grass area, top-down 3/4 RPG map asset.

Asset contract:
- Target id: oval_track_01
- Category: large_prop
- Source canvas: 256x160 px
- Footprint in map: 8x5 tiles
- Runtime size: 256x160 px
- Tile size: 32x32 px
- Anchor: center

Output requirements:
- Pixel art, top-down 3/4 RPG view.
- Transparent background only; no terrain, no floor, no scene background.
- Draw exactly this object, centered and readable.
